skills.Place: Place an object with specified relation (at, on, inside) (e.g. Place Cup Inside microwave, place apple On countertop).
skills.navigate: Navigate to a specific location in the environment.
skills.Open: Open an object (e.g. open microwave door or fridge door)
skills.Close: Close an object (e.g. close microwave door or fridge door)
skills.Toggle_On: Turn on an object (e.g. microwave or coffee machine)
skills.Toggle_Off: Turn off an object (e.g. microwave or coffee machine)

conditions.At_Pos: Check if object is at position
conditions.grasped: Check if object is in robot's gripper
conditions.Location_Known: Check if object location is known
conditions.Near_Robot: Check if object is within reacht
conditions.Toggled: Check if object is turned on
